caption:
Comment “AI” to get the link and the full list of free AI resources.

Someone just leaked the system prompts behind GPT-6 Astra and Fable 5.1. All in the same repo.

It’s system_prompts_leaks, a collection of extracted system prompts from popular AI products. What it has:

> 401 prompt files across 16 providers
> OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Grok, Kimi, and more
> hidden rules for tools, coding, browsing, etc.
> multiple versions to compare how prompts evolve

clone it with:
git clone https://github.com/asgeirtj/system_prompts_leaks

100% free & open-source.
